text_block_list.text:
Matikane Fukukitaru said she incorporated 
choreography she saw in a dream into her 
dance, so I came to watch—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, here it comes, Trainer! Feast your 
eyes on my good luck dance~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Crawl slooowly across the floor...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And slowly raise your right leg toward 
the sky! Toaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How was that!? Did you feel the miraculous 
grace of my choreography!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Crawl along the ground and then thrust up 
with your right leg— didn't that feel 
incredibly "lucky" to you!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyafun! That's not true~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, but it's understandable that you 
mistook it! You must have felt the soaring 
good fortune, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand! Right after I 
finished it, I was so moved I was 
completely lost for words!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, I'd love to try this out in 
an actual live performance right away!

I felt the enthusiasm, but performing that 
at a flashy post-race concert might be a 
bit out of place...
choice_data_list:
Alright, nothing to lose—let's try it 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No harm in trying?! As in, nothing to 
lose, so give it a shot anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm a tiny bit shocked, but...! Actually, 
now I'm even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maintain the movements of the prophecy...! 
Without extinguishing the hidden flame...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I shall polish this dance so it shines 
the brightest on stage~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I need to dream 
it again and learn! I'm gonna go take a 
quick nap~!

After waking up, her dance, incorporating 
even more "divinely inspired" movements, 
ended up becoming extraordinarily dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oho! Brisk and lively... you say?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Munununu, no unnecessary movements then! 
In that case, trim this, skip that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Ooh? Ooooh~!? Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Boom-chiki-boom-chiki♪ Hey, maaaan! The 
long-awaited Matikanefukukitaru is here, 
offering prayers and clapping hands right 
here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
True believers, put your hands up! 
Non-believers, listen up to my hakke!!!! 
*Aiiiight*!!!!

After trying to move briskly like a proper 
dancer, it somehow turned into a hip-hop 
routine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~! I can't wait for the day we can 
deliver it to everyone!

Full of motivation, she continued her 
practice afterward, resulting in a very 
pop-style dance.
